record.category: sandbox (hosted macOS and Linux development VM)
record.tier: Basic Tier 1, 14-day trial then USD 20 per month

free_tier.stated: a 14-day trial gives the Tier 1 allocation of 8 hours per OS with 1 concurrent VM; a credit card is required at signup for verification only and is not charged, and the trial does not auto-convert to a paid plan
free_tier.notes: 8 hours per OS is 480 minutes; each OS has its own pool. After the trial, Basic starts at USD 20 per month billed monthly (USD 18 per month billed annually) with up to 480 included minutes per OS; RDE is billed separately from Bitrise CI build credits

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a development VM, not a stored object

retention.stated: a terminated session's persistent disk is kept indefinitely as long as the user does not delete it and the stack it was created from remains available; session disks are not backed up and are erased if the stack is removed

egress.terms: no separate session-storage or egress price is published on the page read; session storage is not billed separately today, and enterprise agreements define a storage allowance

record.interface_detail: a session is created from the terminal, IDE, browser UI or an AI coding agent; a REST API creates, reads, updates and deletes sessions, templates and saved inputs; a VNC desktop is exposed for macOS sessions
record.tooling: the Bitrise CLI with bitrise-cli auth login and bitrise-cli rde, an RDE MCP server for AI agents, a VS Code plugin, a browser UI and a REST API
record.chaining: an archive-and-restore development VM that keeps its disk between sessions, so a mobile project can be picked up later on the same stack; GitHub integration plants a short-lived token so git and the gh CLI authenticate as the user

limits.value: 480 included minutes per OS per month at Basic Tier 1, then macOS USD 0.0288/min and Linux USD 0.0044/min up to a monthly cap of USD 99 macOS and USD 39 Linux
a workspace owner or manager must enable RDE and grant the RDE User role before a member can start a session

record.binding_note: access is granted per workspace: membership alone is not enough, so a new user is stopped by the RDE User role before the 8-hour trial cap or the per-minute overage comes into play

identity_cost.detail: the 14-day trial requires a credit card at signup for verification only, with no charge and no subscription; a workspace owner or manager must enable RDE and grant the RDE User role, and the CLI sign-in opens a browser to authenticate a Bitrise account

record.reliability_note: session disks are working storage with no backup and no service-level commitment; a session on a removed stack is unrecoverable, and long-running machines are drained for infrastructure maintenance even with the auto-terminate timer disabled
record.confidence_note: the trial, price, minute pools, overage rates, monthly caps and identity gate are quoted from first-party pricing, FAQ and quickstart pages read on 2026-11-25; no session was created
